questions.question_text: What is the Internet?

answer_key.model_answer: The Internet is a global network that connects millions and billions of computers throughout the world. It uses the standard Internet protocol suite called TCP/IP to exchange data and information.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark for global network; 1 mark for connecting computers worldwide; 1 mark for TCP/IP or data exchange.
answer_key.important_keywords: global network, computers, TCP/IP, data exchange

questions.question_text: Name any three popular services provided by the Internet.

answer_key.model_answer: Three popular Internet services are: 1. World Wide Web 2. Email 3. Social Media. Other services mentioned are online games and software updates.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark for each correct service.
answer_key.important_keywords: World Wide Web, Email, Social Media, online games, software updates

questions.question_text: What is a web browser?

answer_key.model_answer: A web browser is a software application used to access information on the World Wide Web. It fetches data from a web server and displays the web page on the user's screen.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark software application; 1 mark access WWW; 1 mark fetches and displays webpage.
answer_key.important_keywords: software application, World Wide Web, web server, webpage

questions.question_text: Write any three functions of a web browser.

answer_key.model_answer: Three functions are: 1. Retrieves information from the World Wide Web. 2. Opens websites using URLs and helps users follow hyperlinks. 3. Stores web page data in internal cache and allows pages to be opened again.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark for each correct function.
answer_key.important_keywords: retrieve information, URL, hyperlinks, internal cache

questions.question_text: Name any three web browsers mentioned in the notes.

answer_key.model_answer: Any three are: 1. Netscape Navigator 2. Internet Explorer 3. Firefox. Google Chrome and WorldWideWeb are also mentioned.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark for each correct browser.
answer_key.important_keywords: Netscape Navigator, Internet Explorer, Firefox, Google Chrome

questions.question_text: Define a web server and state its main use.

answer_key.model_answer: A web server is a computer where web content is stored. Its main use is to host websites and provide web content when a client requests it.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark definition; 1 mark stores web content; 1 mark hosts websites/responds to clients.
answer_key.important_keywords: computer, web content, host websites, client request

questions.question_text: State the two ways in which a web server responds to a client request.

answer_key.model_answer: A web server responds in two ways: 1. It sends the file associated with the requested URL to the client. 2. It generates a response by invoking a script and communicating with a database.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1.5 marks for each correct method.
answer_key.important_keywords: requested URL, sends file, script, database

questions.question_text: What is a URL? Write its general syntax.

answer_key.model_answer: URL stands for Uniform Resource Locator. It is used to address a document or other data on the web. Syntax: scheme://prefix.domain:port/path/filename
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark full form; 1 mark purpose; 1 mark syntax.
answer_key.important_keywords: Uniform Resource Locator, address, web resource, scheme, domain, path

questions.question_text: What is the function of the scheme, domain and port in a URL?

answer_key.model_answer: Scheme defines the type of Internet service, such as HTTP or HTTPS. Domain specifies the Internet domain name. Port specifies the port number at the host; the default port for HTTP is 80.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark for each component.
answer_key.important_keywords: scheme, HTTP, HTTPS, domain name, port, 80

questions.question_text: What is a URI? Give one example.

answer_key.model_answer: URI stands for Uniform Resource Identifier. It is a string of characters used to identify a name or a resource. An ISBN of a book is an example of a URI.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark full form; 1 mark definition; 1 mark example.
answer_key.important_keywords: Uniform Resource Identifier, string of characters, identify resource, ISBN

questions.question_text: State any three differences between URI and URL.

answer_key.model_answer: URI identifies a resource by its name or location, while URL identifies the location or address of a resource on the web. URI includes URN and URL as subsets. Every URL is a URI, but every URI is not a URL.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark for each correct difference.
answer_key.important_keywords: identify resource, location, URN, URL, every URL is a URI

questions.question_text: What is HTTP? State its main use.

answer_key.model_answer: HTTP stands for HyperText Transfer Protocol. It is a protocol used to access data on the World Wide Web. It can transfer plain text, hypertext, audio and video.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark full form; 1 mark protocol/use; 1 mark types of data.
answer_key.important_keywords: HyperText Transfer Protocol, World Wide Web, plain text, hypertext, audio, video

questions.question_text: Explain any three features of HTTP.

answer_key.model_answer: 1. Connectionless: The connection exists only during the current request and response. 2. Media independent: Different types of data can be sent if both client and server can handle them. 3. Stateless: Client and server do not retain information between separate requests.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark for each correctly explained feature.
answer_key.important_keywords: connectionless, media independent, stateless, request, response

questions.question_text: What are the two messages exchanged in an HTTP transaction?

answer_key.model_answer: The two messages are: 1. Request message: sent by the client to the server to start a transaction. 2. Response message: sent by the server to the client as a reply.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark for request; 1 mark for response; 1 mark for direction/purpose.
answer_key.important_keywords: request message, client, server, response message

questions.question_text: What is SMTP? State its main purpose.

answer_key.model_answer: SMTP stands for Simple Mail Transfer Protocol. It is used by software to transmit electronic mail over the Internet and provides rules for communication between mail servers.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark full form; 1 mark email transfer; 1 mark communication rules.
answer_key.important_keywords: Simple Mail Transfer Protocol, electronic mail, Internet, mail servers

questions.question_text: Name the two main components of SMTP and state their functions.

answer_key.model_answer: The two components are: 1. User Agent (UA): prepares the message and creates the envelope. 2. Mail Transfer Agent (MTA): transfers the mail across the Internet.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark for each component; 1 mark for functions.
answer_key.important_keywords: User Agent, UA, Mail Transfer Agent, MTA, message, envelope

questions.question_text: What are the two parts of an email message?

answer_key.model_answer: An email message has two parts: 1. Header: contains sender address, recipient address and subject information. 2. Body: contains the main content of the message.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark for naming both parts; 1 mark header; 1 mark body.
answer_key.important_keywords: header, body, sender, recipient, subject, message content

questions.question_text: What is the use of an MX record in SMTP?

answer_key.model_answer: During email delivery, the Mail Transfer Agent checks the MX record in the Domain Name System to find the target mail domain/server for the recipient's email address.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark MTA; 1 mark MX record/DNS; 1 mark target mail server.
answer_key.important_keywords: MTA, MX record, DNS, target domain, mail server

questions.question_text: What is FTP? State any two uses.

answer_key.model_answer: FTP stands for File Transfer Protocol. It is a TCP/IP Internet protocol used to transfer files from one host to another. It is used to transfer web page files to a server and to download files from other servers.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark full form; 1 mark definition; 1 mark any two uses.
answer_key.important_keywords: File Transfer Protocol, TCP/IP, transfer files, web page files, download

questions.question_text: Write any three advantages of FTP.

answer_key.model_answer: Three advantages of FTP are: 1. Speed: it transfers files quickly. 2. Efficiency: it transfers files efficiently. 3. Back and forth movement: it allows files to be transferred in both directions. Login using username and password is also mentioned in the notes.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark for each advantage.
answer_key.important_keywords: speed, efficient, back and forth movement, username, password

questions.question_text: What is HTML? State its main use.

answer_key.model_answer: HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language. It is a markup language used for creating web pages and web applications. HTML documents contain tags that describe the content of a web page.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark full form; 1 mark definition; 1 mark use/tags.
answer_key.important_keywords: HyperText Markup Language, markup language, web pages, web applications, tags

questions.question_text: What is HyperText?

answer_key.model_answer: HyperText means text within text. It is text that contains a link. By clicking the link, a user can move to another web page or HTML document.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark meaning; 1 mark contains link; 1 mark navigation to another page.
answer_key.important_keywords: text within text, link, click, web page, HTML document

questions.question_text: State the functions of the <head>, <title> and <body> tags.

answer_key.model_answer: <head> contains metadata or information about the document. <title> defines the page title displayed at the top of the browser window or tab. <body> contains the main content visible to the user.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark for each tag.
answer_key.important_keywords: head, metadata, title, browser window, body, visible content

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of the <article>, <nav> and <mark> tags?

answer_key.model_answer: <article> represents independent content that can stand alone, such as a blog post. <nav> defines a set of navigation links. <mark> is used to highlight text.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark for each tag.
answer_key.important_keywords: article, independent content, nav, navigation links, mark, highlight

questions.question_text: What is CSS? State any two benefits of CSS.

answer_key.model_answer: CSS stands for Cascading Style Sheets. It describes the look and formatting of HTML documents. Benefits: 1. It saves time because one external CSS file can style multiple pages. 2. It provides more detailed styling attributes than plain HTML.
answer_key.marking_rubric: 1 mark full form; 1 mark definition; 1 mark any two benefits.
answer_key.important_keywords: Cascading Style Sheets, formatting, saves time, external CSS, styling attributes
